jobs.description:
Combine your AI expertise, data knowledge, and business development skills to help organizations successfully adopt innovative technology solutions.

Our partner is a fast-growing Belgian technology company specializing in helping organizations unlock the full potential of Artificial Intelligence and Data-driven solutions.

To support its commercial expansion, the company is looking for a hybrid profile capable of bridging the gap between business challenges and emerging technologies.

You will operate in a role combining Data, AI, and business development, with regular interactions with clients and prospects across Brussels and the surrounding area.
AI & Data Engineer | The Role
• Identify new business opportunities within organizations looking to expand their AI and Data initiatives.
• Understand client business challenges and translate them into high-value technology solutions.
• Present and promote solutions related to Data Science, Generative AI, and Intelligent Automation.
• Collaborate closely with technical teams to build proposals tailored to customer needs.
• Participate in client meetings, demos, discovery workshops, and project qualification sessions.
• Contribute to the company's commercial strategy and overall business growth.
AI & Data Engineer | The Profile
• You have a solid understanding of Data Science, Machine Learning, Generative AI, or Advanced Analytics concepts.
• You enjoy client-facing interactions, business development, and identifying new opportunities.
• You are capable of explaining complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
• You are results-oriented, highly autonomous, and possess a genuine entrepreneurial mindset.
• You are a native Dutch speaker, fluent in French, and have an excellent command of English.
• You are motivated to join an agile organization where your contribution will have a visible and direct impact on the company's growth.

As a Sales Representative, you will develop new business opportunities and build long-term relationships with clients across Belgium. Working in a dynamic international environment, you will contribute directly to the company's growth while developing your commercial skills.

Client Details

Our client is a growing international company with a strong presence across Europe. Known for its customer-focused approach and innovative solutions, the company supports businesses in improving their operational performance and continues to invest in ambitious commercial talent.

Description

As a Sales Representative (FR/NL) - International Company, your responsibilities will include:

 

• Actively identify and approach prospective clients across Belgium to generate new business opportunities.
• Schedule and conduct client meetings to understand business needs and present tailored solutions.
• Build and manage a strong sales pipeline through prospecting, networking and lead follow-up activities.
• Negotiate commercial agreements and manage opportunities from initial contact through to successful closure.
• Maintain accurate records in the CRM system and contribute to the achievement of individual and team sales targets.
 

 

 

A successful Sales Representative (Fr/Nl) - International Company should have:

 

• Fluency in French and Dutch, with a professional command of English.
• A Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience.
• Up to 3 years of experience in sales, customer service, business development or a client-facing role.
• Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
• A proactive, commercial mindset with the motivation to achieve and exceed targets.

What if the systems you engineer don’t just work on paper, but actually power, control, and bring real machines to life? At M-ECS, as a System Engineer – Electrical & Automation, you’ll design, develop, and integrate the electrical and automation systems behind off-highway vehicles and other intelligent machines. Working at the intersection of electrical engineering, automation, embedded systems and system integration, you'll turn technical concepts into reliable solutions that perform in the real world.You’ll see your work move from 
idea → concept → system → real-world impact.
 

 
 

ABOUT M-ECSAt M-ECS, we're more than an engineering firm. We're an 
end-to-end system builder, designing and delivering sm 
art, electrified and automated systems across 
demanding, asset-intensive industries, including aviation & logistics, railways & infrastructure, offshore, agriculture, construction and ports. Companies we’ve had the pleasure to work with: Mobix, Carro-Bel, TCR, Swissport, DEME, SMT, Depoortere…
 

Engineering we’re proud of:
 
 

• Diesel-to-electric conversions of tow tractors and mobile staircases 

• Our own electric tow tractors (shire.eu) 

• Custom electrical power packs for screed trucks 

• Semi-autonomous drilling robot 

• Height and positioning measurement system for railway infrastructure 

• Traceability system for agricultural applications and an accompanying IoT platform 

• …  

Our mission? 
Engineering Efficiency. Delivering Impact.At M-ECS, we believe technology only works when it performs where it matters most: in the field. We connect the dots across disciplines and engineer solutions until they make sense across every dimension: operational, financial, environmental and human.
 

M-ECS, 
 Engineering that just makes sense.
 

 
 

 
 

YOUR ROLE, YOUR IMPACT. 
As a hands-on 
System Engineer with a strong focus on 
Electrical & Automation Engineering, you’ll take ownership of the technical development and integration of intelligent vehicles and systems. 
From translating customer requirements into technical concepts to designing electrical architectures, programming control systems and commissioning complete machines, you'll be involved throughout the entire engineering process. You’ll connect electrical, automation, software, hydraulics, and mechanical systems, bringing different technologies and components together into 
 one integrated system that performs reliable in the field. 
Key responsibilities: 
 
 

• Concept & Solution Engineering: Translate customer needs into genius technical concepts and system architectures, challenging requirements where needed. 

• Electrical Engineering: Design and integrate electrical architectures, components, wiring, sensors, actuators, and communication systems. 

• Software, Automation & Controls: Develop and program machine functions and control logic using PLCs and ECUs, and integrate embedded control systems. 

• System Integration & Commissioning: Build, test, debug and fine-tune prototypes and machines, ensuring all systems work seamlessly together. 

• Field Support & Improvement: Troubleshoot technical issues, support and train customers, and use field feedback to continuously improve performance and reliability.  

ARE YOU THE ONE? You’re a hands-on Electrical & Automation Engineer with a natural 
curiosity for 
how things work. You enjoy understanding complex challenges and systems, developing creative solutions, and finding ways to make things work even better. You don’t stop at the drawing board. You love building, programming, testing, and debugging real machines. You get energy from solving technical problems and seeing your engineering work come to life in the real world.
 

You combine 
analytical thinking, 
creativity, and 
practical problem-solving. You take 
ownership, think beyond the obvious and aren't afraid to 
explore new approaches when there's no straightforward answer or manual to follow. You're comfortable working 
independently but also enjoy 
collaborating with colleagues and customers. Most importantly, you thrive in a fast-paced, ambitious environment where you can 
learn by doing, tackle challenging projects and make a tangible impact with your work.
 
 

• A 
master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Electromechanics, Mechatronics, Systems Engineering, or a comparable combination of education and practical experience. 

• Ideally 
3–5 years of relevant experience in a similar engineering role, working with electrical systems, automation, controls, or embedded systems. 

• A strong interest in (off-highway) vehicles, robotics, and/or intelligent machines. 

• Knowledge of or familiarity with: 
 

• PLC programming, preferably CODESYS (Structured Text) 

• CAN-bus and/or other machine communication protocols 

• EPLAN and electrical design   

• Good communication skills in 
Dutch and 
English. 

• A 
driver’s license and a willingness to travel occasionally, in Belgium and abroad.

jobs.occupation: Commissioning & Qualification Equipment Engineer | Pharma | Beerse
jobs.description:
As a Commissioning & Qualification Equipment Engineer, you are responsible for preparing, maintaining and executing qualification documentation for GMP-critical equipment, utilities and systems. You ensure that all documentation complies with applicable GMP requirements and internal quality standards. You work closely with C&Q Leads, Subject Matter Experts and project teams to support qualification projects from initiation through completion. Besides document preparation, you also participate in qualification testing and follow-up activities. Your work plays an important role in ensuring that systems remain in a validated and compliant state.
Fortunately, we can count on you for:

 
• Writing qualification documentation including URS, SRS, IA, DQ, IQ, OQ, PQ, QSR and Validation Master Plans
 
• Executing and documenting qualification tests for equipment, utilities and systems
 
• Assessing the impact of changes, deviations and discrepancies on qualification activities
 
• Coordinating document reviews, approval flows and signature processes
 
• Following up punch list items and qualification actions until closure
 
• Supporting internal and external audits and inspections
 
• Managing document archiving in accordance with GMP and GDP requirements

You are structured, quality-minded and eager to learn. You communicate effectively with different stakeholders and enjoy working in a team-oriented GMP environment. At the same time, you are capable of independently managing documentation and qualification activities.

What you bring

 
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a scientific or technical field such as Industrial Engineering, Biochemistry, Biotechnology or Pharmaceutical Sciences
 
• Strong interest in the pharmaceutical industry and GMP-regulated environments
 
• Excellent technical writing and documentation skills
 
• Experience with engineering systems, utilities or manufacturing equipment is an asset
 
• Fluent in Dutch and English, both written and spoken

Introduction
 

Our truck factory in Ghent is the largest Volvo Group truck factory worldwide. Every day, almost 3000 colleagues assemble top-quality trucks here. Innovation and continuous improvement are standard on our agenda, and that from day 1. We therefore firmly believe in the philosophy of Lean Manufacturing, in which attention to quality, safety and the environment are our top priority. Our site today has many different departments, but we all have one thing in common: passion for what we do. 
 

Meet your team
 

You will join a team of engineers who work both independently and in a team. Together we support each other to give the customer a qualitative and feasible solution to meet the desired truck specifications.
 

Your ideal job?
 

On our assembly line and in the Market Adaptation Center, all requests for a customized truck are handled according to the following principle: Our customer? He is king. Do you have good technical insight and would you like to take on the challenge with us to support the customer in the design of the ideal truck?
 

Your tasks:
 
 

• Investigate and answer customer questions about technical concepts that are not offered as a standard. This in terms of technical feasibility, cost price, lead time & legal compliance.  

• Advising other departments on technical product solutions to adapt standard trucks to customer demand. In doing so, you make decisions independently and take final responsibility for these concepts. 

• You ensure optimal coordination and cooperation between various parties involved (design, order planning, suppliers, sales engineers) so that the production of the designs is ensured efficiently and on time. 

• Continuously polish your technical knowledge & keep your product knowledge up-to-date 

Who are you?
 
 

• Minimum bachelor's degree, preferably in a technical field. Additional knowledge in economics can be an added value. Technical knowledge related to vehicles and/or knowledge of the automotive industry is an advantage. 

• Being able to work in a team is a must. You easily make contacts and maintain good relationships with others. 

• Be administrative, organizational, and commercially skilled. 

• Have excellent networking skills. 

• Good knowledge of MS Office. 

• Good knowledge of English is a requirement (other languages are an advantage).

Introduction
 

Volvo Action Service (VAS) takes care of our Volvo Group customers across Europe whenever one of their vehicles has a problem. Delivering great customer service is at the heart of our operation, as we take a proactive approach to get vehicles back on the road as quickly and smoothly as possible.
 

This is us, your new colleagues
 

You will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.
 

We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.
 

This is the job
 
 

• Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind. 

• Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress. 

• A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box. 

• Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business 

Are you the one?
 
 

• You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers. 

• You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported. 

• You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset. 

• You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up. 

• You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills. 

• You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients. 

• You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Dutch and German. French is an asset.

jobs.occupation: Oliver James Associates - Senior .NET Developer / SQL Server & Manufacturing Applications
jobs.description:
Oliver James is looking for a Senior .NET Developer for an international manufacturer. You'll work on an in-house Manufacturing Execution System (MES) that has been in use for 15 years. Factory teams use the application across several sites to manage production recipes, manufacturing processes and quality checks.

SQL Server is the main technical requirement. The application handles millions of records. You'll need to investigate performance issues independently and decide when to change a query, an index or the way a table is partitioned. You'll also develop new features in ASP.NET and help migrate the application to a newer version of .NET.
What you'll do

You'll work alongside the person who built the application and gradually take ownership of changes from the first conversation with factory users through to delivery. For example, if a plant needs to change a quality check, you'll speak directly with the people who perform it, understand why the current process needs to change, discuss the technical impact, implement the change and validate it with the users.

You'll be expected to reach out to production, quality and IT stakeholders yourself. That includes visiting factories when it helps you understand how a process works on the floor. Several of your business contacts are based in Spain, and the client covers travel expenses.
What you'll bring

• Advanced SQL Server skills. You can write and optimise complex queries, read execution plans and make indexing and partitioning decisions on tables with millions of rows.

• Hands-on .NET and ASP.NET experience. You're comfortable finding your way around an established web application, extending it and contributing to its migration.

• Experience in an industrial or manufacturing environment. You've worked directly with people involved in industrial operations and understand how changes to software can affect their daily work.

• Experience with MES, production workflows or quality systems is particularly relevant.

• Functional analysis and ownership. You've taken a request from a business user, clarified the underlying need with business and technical stakeholders, and delivered the change yourself.

• Practical use of AI tools. You can use approved AI tools to help analyse requirements or develop a solution, check the output and work within the client's guidelines.

• Professional English. You can run discussions with factory users and technical colleagues in English. English is the only required language.

The selection process involves two to three interviews, including discussions with the technical lead and business stakeholders.

What if you could lead the development of the intelligence that makes industrial machines autonomous?
 

At M-ECS, you'll help shape the next generation of autonomous off-highway vehicles and mobile robotic platforms. You'll lead an ambitious autonomous driving project, developing the systems that allow machines to perceive and understand their surroundings, determine where they are, decide where to go and navigate safely through complex industrial environments. You'll bring together two key domains: Computer Vision & Perception and Autonomous Navigation & SLAM.
 

As Team Lead Autonomous Driving, you'll take ownership of the entire project, from defining the technical vision and architecture to managing development, setting priorities and leading a multidisciplinary engineering team. Combining strategic leadership with technical expertise and a hands-on mindset, you'll turn bold ideas into technology that works in the field.
 

This is a unique opportunity to lead a prestigious innovation project, partly supported by VLAIO (Flanders Innovation & Entrepreneurship), and make a lasting impact on the future of autonomous machines. You’ll see your work move from 
concept → 
algorithm → system → real-world impact.
 

 
 

YOUR ROLE, YOUR IMPACT. 
 

As 
Team Lead Autonomous Driving, you'll take end-to-end ownership of M-ECS' autonomous driving capabilities. You'll connect the dots between perception, localization, mapping, planning and decision-making, ensuring all components work together as one intelligent system. You'll drive technical development and project execution, lead the team and stay closely involved in the engineering challenges, from code to real-world testing.
 

Key responsibilities: 
 
 

• Defining the vision and strategy: Translating business and project objectives into a clear technical vision, roadmap and development strategy for the full autonomy stack. 

• Driving technical architecture: Overseeing the architecture and integration of perception, sensor fusion, localization, SLAM, mapping, path planning, trajectory generation and behavioral decision-making. 

• Managing projects and priorities: Planning and coordinating development activities, setting priorities, managing resources, project budgets, and timelines, monitoring progress and ensuring projects are delivered efficiently and within budget. 

• Leading the team: Building, coaching and motivating a multidisciplinary team of engineers. 

• Hands-on development: Actively contributing to the development of the autonomy stack, getting involved in coding, prototyping and solving complex technical challenges. 

• Testing and validation: Ensuring algorithms and software are tested, optimized and validated on actual machines, under real operating conditions. 

• Ensuring technical excellence: Guiding key engineering decisions, establishing technical standards and overseeing system requirements, technical documentation, quality, performance and scalability of the solutions. 

• Ensuring system integration and alignment: Working closely with our engineers, management and customers to integrate the autonomy stack into real machines and align technical solutions with project goals, customer needs, and the broader M-ECS strategy. 

ARE YOU THE ONE? We're looking for a 
technical leader who combines a 
strong background in robotics and 
autonomous systems with the 
ability to lead people, projects and technology. You're comfortable switching between the bigger picture and the 
technical details. You can define a strategy, drive projects forward and make key decisions, but you're equally eager to get hands-on, explore different technologies and tackle complex engineering challenges alongside your team. You're 
proactive, 
pragmatic and 
results-driven. You enjoy bringing people and disciplines together, creating structure in complex projects and turning ambitious ideas into technology that works in the real world.
 
 

• A 
Master's or PhD degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Automation, AI, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 

• 5+ years of relevant experience in robotics, autonomous vehicles, or industrial automation. 

• Experience with or solid 
technical knowledge of: 
 

• Computer Vision & Perception, including deep learning and object detection. 

• Sensor fusion using cameras, LiDAR, radar, IMU and GNSS. 

• Autonomous Navigation & SLAM, including localization, 2D/3D mapping, path planning and behavioral decision-making. 

• C++ and Python programming, preferably ROS/ROS2. 

• 3D geometry, coordinate transformations, kinematics and real-time system constraints.

managing technical projects.

English and 
Dutch.

jobs.occupation: IT Tribe Architect - DevEx & Cloud - HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

The Architecture Department at BNP Paribas Fortis is the strategic backbone of our digital transformation.

We design the future of banking by shaping secure, scalable, and innovative technology solutions that align business vision with cutting-edge IT. Our team of expert architects bridges the gap between security, agility, and customer-centric innovation, ensuring every system-from cloud to core banking-is built for performance, compliance, and seamless integration.

AND IN DETAIL

• You will design and validate solutions for development frameworks, platforms, and toolchains, enabling Dev Engineers to build and deploy scalable cloud-native applications.
• You will produce and maintain high-quality architecture documentation—including blueprints, solution architectures, and reference architectures—to ensure alignment with architectural standards, security policies, and business requirements.
• You will support other architects and development teams by providing expert guidance on scalable, resilient design patterns and cloud-native best practices.
• You will demystify complex technical concepts (e.g., service mesh, continuous delivery, infrastructure automation) to ensure solutions are secure, performant, and developer friendly.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

• Cloud-Native Development: Deep expertise in designing, implementing, and optimizing cloud-native applications (microservices, containers) with a focus on scalability, resilience, and observability.
• Kubernetes & OpenShift: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Red Hat OpenShift 
• IBM Cloud Platform: Proficiency in IBM Cloud services (e.g., Openshift and other native IBM Cloud services like EventStream, COS,…)
• Toolchain & Automation: Strong background in DevOps toolchains (CI/CD pipelines, GitOps) and infrastructure automation (Terraform, Ansible, scripting) to streamline development and deployment workflows.
• Java Frameworks: Experience with modern Java frameworks (Spring Boot) and their integration with cloud-native ecosystems.
• Developer Experience (DevEx): Ability to design and improve developer tools, platforms, and workflows to enhance productivity, reduce friction, and foster adoption of cloud-native practices.
• You are fluent in English (oral and written). Basic knowledge of Dutch or French is an asset.

Are you passionate about IT, enjoy solving technical problems, and like helping people?We are looking for an enthusiastic IT Support Intern to join our team and gain hands-on experience in a professional IT environment.

During your 3 months internship, you will work alongside experienced IT colleagues, support end users, and develop your knowledge of workplace technology, troubleshooting, ticket management, and IT processes.

What You Will Do

As an IT Service Desk Intern, you will support the team with day-to-day IT activities, including:

• Providing 1st-line IT support to users via phone and email
• Creating, updating, and following up on incidents and requests in our Helpdesk ticketing system
• Troubleshooting issues related to Windows 10/11, Microsoft 365, PCs, printers, smartphones and peripherals
• Supporting basic user and access management, including Active Directory
• Preparing and staging laptops, PCs and other hardware for users
• Assisting with basic network, Wi-Fi and VPN troubleshooting
• Supporting meeting room technology and videoconferencing equipment
• Following technical procedures, checklists and IT processes
• Escalating more complex technical issues to experienced colleagues
• Contributing to a professional and customer-focused IT support experience

Who We're Looking For

You do not need to be an IT expert yet. We are looking for someone who is eager to learn and interested in developing a career in IT support.

Ideally, you:

• Are currently studying IT, System & Network Administration, or a related field
• Have a basic understanding of Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365
• Have an interest in hardware, networking, Wi-Fi, VPN and IT infrastructure
